shots.text: At Brazier Hold the Saltmother came up the road herself, inside a column of black seawater. She had been the high priestess of the Tidefolk. Two years ago she went east to the Rift, and nobody knew why.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Saltmother's water-column bursting apart on the steps, fish and drowned lanterns scattering. Her empty grey eyes going dark.

shots.text: When she fell, we found a cage of salt on the steps. In it was Brannoc Emberhand, the smith who forged Solenne's gates. She had kept him nine days to make him forge chains for her army.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A cage of crusted salt breaking open. Brannoc Emberhand, huge, bald, brass-ringed beard, staggering out and grabbing his hammer from the rubble; its head flares orange.

shots.text:
Nine days she asked me for chains. Nine days I told her no.

Now give me a wall to stand on.
shots.speaker: brannoc
shots.art_note: Brannoc on the wall of Brazier Hold, hammer on his shoulder, grinning. Joins as a hero.
